hypotheses.estimator: paired mean daily account net return
paired mean daily account net return

hypotheses.contrast: registered CAL degradation minus REGIME degradation H1->H3
hypotheses.estimator: mean of pre-registered matched calendar/context age-cohort return gaps

hypotheses.contrast: regime conditional minus unconditional future candidate utility ranking
hypotheses.estimator: time-block held-out incremental rank correlation on fixed candidate/target/cohort

family.name: confirmatory_four
family.adjustment: Holm step-down over all four one-sided p-values, including blocked hypotheses represented as 1.0 for multiplicity only
family.blocked_metric: remains null; p=1 bookkeeping cannot create an evaluable result
family.confidence_intervals: Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided basic intervals with alpha/(2*4) tails; report ordinary 95% intervals separately

aggregation.primary: complete planned 20-cell equal-capital fixed cohort only
aggregation.partial: fixed named common-valid subset determined by capability/coverage, equal weights 1/n; intersect daily dates across its cells, do not change weights row by row
aggregation.full_aggregate_if_missing: NOT_EVALUABLE; partial-scoped descriptive/statistical result kept separately
aggregation.cross_cell_dependence: same resampled calendar blocks across all cells and arms
aggregation.seed_replications: search variability only, not extra independent market samples
aggregation.cell_tests: descriptive intervals unless separate family for all 20 cell tests is registered before outcomes

bootstrap.method: circular moving calendar blocks of centered paired differences
bootstrap.sensitivity_rule: report all, never select the most significant; positive claim additionally must retain direction and hurdle across estimable registered lengths
bootstrap.mean_only_primary: SR/PF re-evaluate whole statistic with valid denominator in each draw; secondary scope

support.insufficient: INCONCLUSIVE_SUPPORT or NOT_EVALUABLE; thresholds are floors, not proof of power

economic_threshold.formula: maximum across prespecified cells of mean calibration-day sum(abs(fill_notional)/pre_fill_equity * delta_one_way_cost)
economic_threshold.calibration_policy: TE-02 qualified M4_CAL on training-only data before initial cutoff, with all flat days retained; not M4_REGIME OOS outcomes
economic_threshold.materialization: numeric value and input trace hashes must be frozen in a separate record before the first TE-04 pair; absent/zero/invalid calibration blocks economic claims
economic_threshold.historical_values: 0.64 and 0.0371 bps/day preserved as history, not silently inherited
economic_threshold.business_hurdle: no independent business hurdle asserted on behalf of the user
economic_threshold.decay_threshold: same frozen account-return/day threshold, with D2 support and attribution restrictions

power_calibration.null_at_economic_boundary: also simulate true effect=delta for false-positive calibration
power_calibration.full_pipeline_precision: do not certify 5% FWER from 20 worlds; sequentially extend by prespecified batches of 20 under budget; if bounds remain undecided record CALIBRATION_INCONCLUSIVE
power_calibration.engine_avoidance: bootstrap draws and statistical calibration reuse generated return paths; no engine call per bootstrap draw
power_calibration.truth: ground-truth regimes and optimal params excluded from features/selector/policy; used only by world generator and evaluation

decay_design.anchors: first eligible actual selection per UTC quarter per cell/arm, selected by timestamp only; all chosen before reading age outcomes
decay_design.common_age_support: full 270-day follow-up before eval end; no padding last anchors
decay_design.comparison: common-quarter strata and calendar/context matched anchor cohort; if no overlap/common support, descriptive association only
decay_design.confounding: age changes with calendar time; adjusted association is not proof of universal causal parameter decay
decay_design.inference_unit: calendar shocks and overlapping anchors jointly resampled, never individual decay rows iid

claims.positive: L > delta AND adjusted_p<=alpha AND risk/control gates pass
claims.equality_paths: diagnose action lineage, never infer an implementation failure from equality alone

risk.turnover_and_exposure: report paired distribution and tail losses; require equal registered leverage/sizing cap

stopping: no outcome-based early stop or unregistered p-value looks; stop for technical invalidity, safety, support or budget; negative results retained
contamination: all current market data retrospective; TE-01 runs no market inference
